description: This file defines a routing strategy class 'LowestTPMLoggingHandler_v2' that manages deployment selection and rate limiting based on TPM (tokens per minute) and RPM (requests per minute). It uses caching, handles rate limit checks, and integrates with telemetry and logging utilities. The core purpose is to log, monitor, and control deployment usage in a distributed model serving environment.

classes.name: RoutingArgs
classes.description: A Pydantic model that defines the TTL (time-to-live) for rate limiting keys, defaulting to 1 minute.

classes.name: LowestTPMLoggingHandler_v2
classes.description: A custom routing strategy class that inherits from BaseRoutingStrategy and CustomLogger, designed to manage deployment selection and rate limit enforcement based on TPM and RPM metrics, with caching and logging functionalities.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] pre_call_check(self, deployment: Dict)
methods.description: Performs pre-call rate limiting checks synchronously, incrementing RPM counters and raising RateLimitError if limits are exceeded.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] async_pre_call_check( self, deployment: Dict, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] )
methods.description: Performs pre-call rate limiting checks asynchronously, suitable for concurrent environments, raising RateLimitError if limits are exceeded.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a successful request, updating TPM counters in the cache.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful request, updating TPM counters.

methods.description: Selects deployments with the lowest TPM, considering usage and RPM constraints.

methods.description: Checks TPM and RPM status across deployments to determine availability.
